section-45-1.TO: — have any bodily material intending— (i) that any human DNA in the material be analysed without qualifying consent, and (ii) that the results of the analysis be used otherwise than for an excepted purpose
section-45-1.IF: (b) the material is not of a kind excepted under subsection (2), and (c) not reasonably believe the material to be of a kind so excepted

section-47-2.FOR: Any body to which this section applies
section-47-2.TO: transfer from their collection any human remains which they reasonably believe to be remains of a person who died less than one thousand years before the day on which this section comes into force
section-47-2.IF: it appears to them to be appropriate to do so for any reason, whether or not relating to their other functions
